text:
Alex: hey team — quick sync on the "ecosystem patrol" sprint: we want a compact set of community assets next week: 2 tutorial vids, 1 refapp walkthrough, a short OSS launch post, plus a benchmark story and a 30-min webinar seed. who can pick which?
Priya: I can own the tutorial vids. thinking: 8-10m each, one 'local dev quickstart', one 'dedicated deploy walkthrough'. simple repo + 1-click run.
Sam: I'll take the refapp walkthrough and OSS launch post. plan to reuse the refapp code from last hackday and update readme + benchmarks.
Olivia: I'll draft the benchmark narrative and webinar outline — want the bench to show latency/cost tradeoffs across hosted vs dedicated. goal: pragmatic, reproducible results.
Alex: solid. timeline: assets ready for review by Tue EOD, publish Thu. can we hit that?
Priya: Tue review ok if I start recordings Mon morning. need quick approvals on script.
Sam: refapp updates need a final integration test — ETA Mon night. OSS post draft Mon.
Olivia: webinar outline + slide skeleton by Mon afternoon. can run a dry-run Wed.
Alex: routing + lead handling: we need inbound flow defined before publish. here's the proposed mapping:
- trial signup or demo request -> sales queue (priority if company_size > 250)
- dev questions, PRs, contributors -> devrel triage channel (#devrel)
- benchmarks/tech deep dives -> product-marketing follow-up
Sam: can we automate tagging from the form? e.g., include a dropdown for "I want: demo / contribute / benchmark" 
Olivia: yes, and capture org size + cloud provider. basic routing pseudocode:
```
if form.choice == "demo":
  if form.org_size > 250: route_to = "sales-enterprise"
  else: route_to = "sales-selfserve"
elif form.choice == "contribute": route_to = "devrel"
elif form.choice == "benchmark": route_to = "pm-bench"
else: route_to = "growth-nurture"
```
Alex: perfect. Sam — can you add the dropdown to the refapp repo's /signup form?
Sam: on it. will also add a hidden utm param for campaign=ecosystem-patrol.
Priya: content promotion: short tweet thread + LinkedIn + community post on GH discussions. draft tweet ideas: "New mini-refapp + tutorial: run Redwood Inference locally in 5 mins -> benchmark results included. Link"
Alex: also prepare an email seed for our developer list. quick A/B on subject lines. Olivia, can you draft 2 subject lines?
Olivia: sure. 1) "New: Run the Redwood refapp + see real cost/latency numbers" 2) "Hands-on: Launch an LLM refapp in 5 mins (benchmarks included)"
Priya: for landing page I'll include 1-click repo clone + CLI snippet:
```
git clone https://github.com/redwood/refapp-mini && cd refapp-mini
./start-local.sh --model redwood-1b
```
Sam: add a badge to README: "Try locally in 1 command" and link to the tutorial vid.
Alex: roles recap: Priya = tutorials + landing; Sam = refapp + OSS post + form update; Olivia = bench + webinar + email copy; Alex = promo cadence + deadlines.
Priya: can we get a quick review checklist? I propose: 1) README check 2) video captions 3) runbook for maintainers 4) form routing validation
Sam: adding integration test to CI to validate form fields + utm.
post-bot: scheduled: reminder posted to #marketing for Tue 10:00 review slot (automated) :bell:
Alex: final checks: analytics hooks (event names: "refapp_started", "form_submitted", "webinar_rsvp") — make sure frontend emits them.
Olivia: I'll add event schema + expected properties to the slide deck and PR description.
Priya: ETA Mon AM for first draft assets. tagging @Sam and @Olivia for review. :rocket:
Alex: awesome. if anything blocks, drop a quick message here. otherwise we aim to publish Thu morning (PST). :thumbsup:
